scope: Local-only independent USDC quote/reviewer/durable reservation/finalized reconciliation with synthetic financial RPC and review metadata; no runtime admission, signing or chain acceptance

captured exact USDC sell builds category 6 with 57 bytes and 41 canonical metas
captured exact USDC sell builds category 7 with 57 bytes and 41 canonical metas
wrong sell payload, changed exact input and weaker output cannot be substituted
only canonical positive u64 input and minimum amounts and supported categories are accepted
pool, base/quote, user vault, market vault and fee-program metas cannot be redirected
unexpected signer, writable privileges, volume tails and missing price separation are rejected
market owner, pool orientation, coin-creator and special-mode changes are rejected
fee recipient membership and canonical WSOL custody are required
conversion decoder rejects unsupported layout, discriminator, category and zero amounts

wrong genesis, loader, authority and full ProgramData context cannot authenticate proof

exact USDC debit and token custody must agree with receipt

reviewed deployment effective before tx authenticates with fresh finalized context and no account cache

unreviewed market, noncanonical limits and widened slippage or liquidity cannot enter pricing

pool/global/fee configuration owners and pool custody must authenticate
reserve token owners, mint decimals, vault authority and frozen accounts cannot be substituted

changed policy, policy digest, role separation or requested program cannot enter review

paused guard, wrong current operator, inactive price signer and used receipt reject new review
category spend cannot exceed token balance or its actual settled allocation

extra transfers, changed writable privileges and reordered fee setup are not canonical

durable actual review reserves signs and reconciles category 6 then permits the next nonce
durable actual review reserves signs and reconciles category 7 then permits the next nonce
same reviewed message is idempotent before and after durable store restart
